summary: The Marcus Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose the planned retirement of Mark A. Gramz, President of Marcus Theatres, effective May 1, 2026, and the appointment of Jeffry F. Tomachek as his successor. Gramz will serve as advisor post-retirement. The filing cites a Board recommendation and press releases. No financial terms, premiums, or break fees are stated. This is a routine succession event, not an activist or strategic change. Watch for any future operational shifts under new leadership.
